name: Remotiko
note: remote roles open to Africa + worldwide

name: Dice
note: robots.txt: /jobs and /job-detail are allowed; /jobs?q= and /jobs/?q= search URLs and /apply-redirect* are disallowed. Browse the /jobs listing and follow /job-detail links. Do not construct search-query URLs.

name: We Work Remotely
note: one of the oldest remote-only boards; robots.txt allows /remote-jobs and the category listings

name: InclusivelyRemote
note: remote roles open worldwide. Each posting is public at /job/<slug>/ and carries schema.org JobPosting markup with the real hiringOrganization. The /jobs/ index and /alerts-jobs/ redirect to a login (/login/?restricted=page) — never follow or file those. Browse the homepage and the public /job-category/<x>/ and /job-type/<x>/ listings instead, open each /job/<slug>/ page, and follow its Apply Now button (class btn-apply-job-external), which links straight to the employer's own ATS. File that employer URL, never the inclusivelyremote.com page.

name: Jobspresso
note: curated remote board that is not tech-only — it keeps separate public category pages at /remote-customer-service-jobs/, /remote-marketing-jobs/, /remote-sales-jobs/, /remote-writing-jobs/, /remote-design-jobs/, /remote-product-management-jobs/, /remote-non-tech-jobs/ and /remote-software-jobs/. Browse the category that matches the candidate's line of work and follow the /job/<slug>/ links; each posting is public and carries the employer's own application link. robots.txt: everything above is allowed, but /*? is disallowed — do NOT build search-query URLs — and it asks for a 3-second crawl delay.

name: BruntWork Careers
note: BruntWork is the EMPLOYER, not an aggregator — it staffs remote roles for its own clients and applications happen on its candidate portal. Do NOT try to follow a posting through to some other company's ATS and do NOT drop it for not having one; the bruntworkcareers.co/jobs/<id> link IS the application page. Heavily non-tech: its own categories are Accounting and Finance, Administration, Customer Support, Marketing and Content, and Sales. The listing is rendered by JavaScript, so the page must be opened rather than fetched. Filter with /jobs/search?category=<Name> (e.g. category=Customer%20Support). robots.txt disallows /api/ only.

name: Truly Remote Work
note: Curated worldwide-remote board — its whole premise is no location locks and no timezone traps, so postings here are unusually likely to be workable from anywhere. Each posting at /jobs/<slug> is public, carries the full description, and links out to the employer's own ATS (Lever, Greenhouse and similar) — follow that link and file the employer's URL, not this one. Public category pages, roughly 30 postings each: /remote-support-jobs, /remote-sales-jobs, /remote-marketing-jobs, /remote-finance-jobs, /remote-hr-jobs, /remote-operations-jobs, /remote-design-jobs, /remote-data-jobs, /remote-product-jobs, /remote-engineering-jobs, /remote-devops-jobs, /remote-security-jobs. Rendered by JavaScript, so open the page rather than fetching it. robots.txt disallows /api/, /partials/ and /newsletter/ only.
